semantics: result := sum over i in [0,N) of DX[i*INCX]*DY[i*INCY]

shape_rules.increments: INCX >= 1 and INCY >= 1. Negative increments are rejected by MAGR (MAGR_STATUS_STRIDE_UNSUPPORTED) even though upstream accepts them, so that Klong and Uiua lowering never depends on reversed traversal.

storage_convention: strided linear vector; element i is at byte offset i*INC*8 from the base pointer.
preconditions: DX and DY are f64, rank 1, with positive byte strides divisible by 8.
Both have the same logical length N.
Declared capacity backs the full strided extent for both.
postconditions: On OK, the double written to the out parameter equals the upstream result.

aliasing.note: DX and DY may be the same memory. The result is then the sum of squares.

numerical_contract.accumulation_order: as implemented upstream (unrolled by 5 in ddot.f)
numerical_contract.reproducibility_note: Summation order is fixed by ddot.f and therefore stable across conforming compilers, modulo FMA contraction inside the compiler-generated loop. Builds requiring bit-identity must pass -ffp-contract=off to the Fortran compiler.
